name: CN_PROCESS_RECOVER_ALL
description: This is a transactional table that will hold the information related to the current state of each ESS request along with the associated checkpoint completed. Once a process has failed ,the restart  logic would examine this table, determine the checkpoint completed and continue the flow from that point onwards.

columns.name: PROCESS_RECOVER_ID
columns.description: Unique number from a running sequence

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CURRENT_PHASE
columns.description: Last completed phase for the job, to be used to determine the restart point

columns.name: CURRENT_PHASE_DESC
columns.description: Description of the last completed phase

columns.name: LOGICAL_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Logical grouping of entities for processing

columns.name: PHYSICAL_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Physical grouping of entities for processing

columns.name: PROCESS_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the process being executed, this name can be different to the Enterprise Service Scheduler job's name

columns.name: WORKER_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Enterprise Service Scheduler request ID for the worker

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
